items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: Mr. D. Clive Hardy of Tulane University staff and I are interviewing Mr. Nick LaRocca

ctx.x: My name is W.R. Hogan. I'm chairman of the history department at Tulane University. And Mr. D. Clive Hardy of Tulane University staff and I are interviewing Mr. Nick LaRocca, the leader of the original Dixieland Jazz Band. Now my purpose in coming here to Mr. LaRocca's home is to sort of wind up the tape recordings which have been conducted over a period of some months. Mr. LaRocca has been ill and he's very kindly gotten up out of a sick bed in order to talk to us. The first questions I have arise out of some…

He spoke German, he spoke French, and Italian, and Portuguese. And he had trade with these boats, these nut boats, they were box. They were sailing vessels. At that time of my early life they had not no steamships. They had steamboats, but not steamships and the wharfs used to be open.
